entry.title: PotentialWax 1.2.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **Overdub** (or STOP) while the MPC was playing could load a different song. The MPC's host briefly "presses" a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was RANDOM TRACK. That first slot now does nothing, and RANDOM TRACK is a new parameter at the end. The transport never changes the loaded song or its playback. - If you had automation or a Q-Link on RANDOM TRACK (unlikely), point it at the new **Random Track** parameter.

entry.title: PotentialWax 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWax 1.2.0**: see your cues. - **New WAVE page:** the song's waveform with all 16 cue points. The selected pad's cue glows, and a white line follows playback. entry.title: PotentialWax 1.1.5
entry.summary: **PotentialWax 1.1.5**: chops that land on the beat. - **Cut loops are recognised.** A file that's a whole number of bars gets its exact tempo from its length, and its cues go on its beat grid (a pad per beat on a 4-bar loop). INFO shows "LOOP 4 BARS". - **Better tempo and cues on real samples:** the tempo and beat grid also listen to the hi-hats, and every cue snaps onto the actual hit nearby. - **New ÷2 / ×2 buttons** in the MATCH panel for half-time and double-time samples. entry.title: PotentialWax 1.1.2
entry.summary: **PotentialWax 1.1.2**, the first public release. A melodic sampler in the spirit of Serato Sample: pick or dig a song from your own library, and get 16 cue points, matched to your project's tempo and key.
